# Vendored ZX0 compressor

This directory contains the command-line compressor sources from Einar
Saukas's ZX0 repository at commit
`ecde3a2ae05061fe06469ed46df81a33b7de7d86` (ZX0 v2.2). The Juku v6 fastboot
builder invokes its classic `-c` format for the Intel 8080 decoder by Ivan
Gorodetsky. The upstream BSD-3-Clause terms are preserved in `LICENSE`.

Upstream: <https://github.com/einar-saukas/ZX0>
